findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/topology-critic-receipt.ts:117-143 — four-dimensional independence is not mechanically established in production: deriveRoleProvenance hard-codes reviewer businessIdentity to the role string, then independenceMatrix compares that synthetic constant with the implementation commit author. The production path therefore cannot observe or fail closed when the critic/scope approver is the same business author; the smoke only injects a synthetic low-level collision that deriveRoleProvenance can never emit. This violates CHK-001/VI-CRITIC-FOUR-DIMENSION-MATRIX and the Wave 2A stop condition against inferred/self-reported independence.
findings.resolvedReason: Commits ffbb3de37d and 1fa77236a5: production derives implementer author from git log and reviewer author from git-var-backed dispatch provenance; fresh owner real-bin smoke rejects same-author and passes four-dimensional matrix.

findings.desc: .claude/agents/lattice-review-topology-critic.md:1 (mirrored in .lattice-codex and packages/main/templates) starts with literal +--- instead of YAML delimiter ---. packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:337-342 requires the first trimmed line to equal ---, so the promised topology-critic host asset cannot be parsed/bootstrapped even though the role is registered. This is an undelivered role entrypoint and must be corrected in all three mirrors with a parser/adapter verification that exercises this template.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit ffbb3de37d: all three critic prompt mirrors use valid YAML frontmatter; parser-backed mirror assertions and fresh 17-role prompt baseline pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/topology-critic-receipt.ts:86 critic/scope-plan dispatch provenance is selected only by role+session and is never checked against the current business commit, HEAD, storyFilesHash, or dispatch envelope binding. A previously valid dispatch in the same session can therefore be replayed after a new implementer commit to mint a newly signed receipt/approval for the changed implementation, violating VI-CRITIC-SESSION-DISPATCH-REPLAY and the promised current dispatch provenance. Bind the selected dispatch envelope/event to the implementation/current material and add the production replay mutation that changes the business commit after dispatch.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit ffbb3de37d: dispatch binds storyId/headHash/storyFilesHash/latest implementer business commit; old dispatch fails after new implementer commit and fresh dispatch restores in owner real-bin smoke.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.ts:142-210 — 21/21 must intents have evidence rows, but the shared smoke does not actually satisfy several claimed contracts. It invokes createProofStoryHandlers directly instead of the registered bin/lattice CLI; the four-dimension cases call the issuer rather than the production verifier; receipt fields are only altered, never individually deleted; signature coverage only replaces signature with forged text (no untrusted re-sign or cross-story/critic/time signature replay); missing/unverifiable signer and implementer provenance is absent; role replay does not cover a different business commit; canonical ref ordering/dedup/nonexistent refs is absent; exclusion coverage only exercises one exclusion and omits zero/multiple, orphan/stale/cross-story plus approver-vs-critic collision/spoof cases; incomplete discovery only covers partial/unsupported, not missing/stale/tampered; restoration is shown only for one approval mutation and never asserts git clean/no reusable forged artifact; process-fact mutations omit the CLI-schema and lifecycle/gate-consumer layers (lines 205-210 only mutate prompt, handler, verifier, incomplete-basis predicate). Add table-driven production-path cases for these missing assertions, including clean→mutation→exact restore, then record fresh intent-specific evidence rather than reusing the broad transcript note.
findings.resolvedReason: Commits ffbb3de37d and 1fa77236a5: fresh owner real-bin smoke covers alter/delete, signature replay, missing provenance, canonical refs, basis missing/stale/tampered, 0/1/N exclusions, approval authority/freshness, new-commit replay, six mutations, exact restore, runtime artifact policy, no proof residue and strict git clean; process/prompt contracts pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/templates/agents/lattice-review-topology-critic.md:1 starts with literal +--- instead of YAML frontmatter delimiter ---. The same malformed first line is mirrored in .claude/agents/lattice-review-topology-critic.md and .lattice-codex/agents/lattice-review-topology-critic.md, so native host discovery/frontmatter parsing cannot load the new role according to the repository agent-asset contract even though raw-text baseline hashing passes. Correct all three mirrors and add a parser/adapter assertion, not only an exact raw hash.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit ffbb3de37d: template/Claude/Codex critic prompts now have valid YAML '---'; native frontmatter parser assertion and prompt baseline pass.

Update the stale audit-boundary count to 17 so the human-readable contract matches the mechanically enforced baseline.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:318-334 defines TopologyCriticReceiptV1 without the required criticProvenance, implementationProvenance, and signerPublicKey fields present in packages/main/src/core/types.ts:450-468 and described later by the Wave 2A implementation contract. Update the canonical schema block so the documented receipt is sufficient to represent the mechanically verified four-dimensional provenance and signer binding.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit ffbb3de37d: execution plan documents criticProvenance, implementationProvenance and signerPublicKey matching production type/verifier.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:486 creates an enforce-mode PLAN→DEV deadlock: the new gate requires a valid critic receipt before DEV, but its producer calls currentImplementationBusinessCommit (packages/main/src/core/topology-critic-receipt.ts:105), which requires an implementer-authored business commit that a normal Story cannot have before entering DEV. The smoke masks this by committing implementation.ts before constructing a PLAN Story (packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.ts:158-164), then changes phase directly to DEV and never executes the PLAN→DEV transition. Add a realistic clean PLAN lifecycle test and use phase-appropriate PLAN provenance/bindings so enforce admission can actually succeed without pre-DEV implementation.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit e99895c94e removed the erroneous topology critic receipt requirement from PLAN→DEV. Fresh owner production smoke exercised an enforce-mode temporary repo with complete structural basis and no critic receipt; real bin/lattice.js story_advance to DEV passed, proving no deadlock.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:483-495 now consumes the independent topology critic receipt as a blocking PLAN→DEV gate whenever acceptance topology mode is enforce, but docs/CLI.md:470-500 and the Wave 2A implementation contract at docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:1376-1401 describe only producer/read-only verification and never disclose this lifecycle consumer or its mode condition. Document that enforce mode requires a fresh valid critic receipt before DEV, while observe/warn behavior remains unchanged; retain the explicit Wave 3/3A/4 non-claims.

packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-topology-critic-smoke.ts:164-206,251-268,287-327 — F-004 is materially improved, but the remaining must coverage is not complete. The fixture directly assigns phase=DEV before issuing the receipt and calls evaluateTopologyCriticReceiptForContext directly; it never drives the registered story_advance PLAN→DEV lifecycle command with proofStory.acceptanceTopologyGateMode=enforce. Therefore VI-WAVE2A-PRODUCTION-CHAIN and VI-PROCESS-FACT-MUTATIONS do not prove the real lifecycle gate can pass a reachable PLAN state (deriveImplementationProvenance currently requires an implementer DEV dispatch/commit before PLAN admission, which the smoke sidesteps). The four-dimensional matrix still tests issueTopologyCriticReceipt rejection rather than re-signed production-verifier inputs with dimension-specific diagnostics; missing provenance covers one missing implementer dispatch plus only three critic event fields, not each signer/implementer comparison input; and the exclusion authority matrix covers a critic-role spoof and one critic-session collision but not implementer/ineligible/same-agent/same-dispatch/same-business-author cases required by VI-EXCLUSION-AUTHORITY-SPOOF. Add one real enforce-mode lifecycle transcript and table-driven verifier/approver matrices, then rerun fresh owner evidence.
